questions.q: Some students [only boys and girls] from different schools appeared for an Olympiad exam. 20% of the boys and 15% of the girls failed the exam. The number of boys who passed the exam was 70 more than that of the girls who passed the exam. A total of 90 students failed. Find the number of students that appeared for the exam.
o: 420
400
500
350
questions.s:
Solution
Let No. of boys & girls be 100B & 100G respectively
Failed student 20B + 15G = 90 ----1
Passed boys = 80B
Passed Girls = 85G
⇒80B=70+85G-----2
By solving eq 1 & 2
G = 2
B = 3
So, total No. of students = 100B + 100G = 200 + 300 = 500

questions.q: 2. Ravi initially had a certain number of chocolates, while Bhanu initially had 80% of the number of chocolates that Ravi initially had. questions.s:
2.(c)

Let Ravi have 100 units of chocolates , then Bhanu has 80 units of chocolates.

Ravi gave chocolates to his sister = 100×10% = 10 units of chocolates

= {AB - 100A - Ap100B - Bq} × 100AB

= {AB - 100A - Ap100B - Bq} × 100AB
=  100AB - ABq - 100AB + ABpB(100B - Bq) × 100AB
=  100(ABp - ABq)B(100B - Bq)AB
= 100AB(p - q)B × B (100 - q)  × BA
= 100(p - q)(100 - q)

questions_hin.q_hi:
Salary of A, B and C are in the ratio of 4 : 5 : 3. If A, B and C donate their 10%, 25% and 15% respectively from their salary. Find the remaining salary of A, B and C together if salary of C is Rs. 36000.

A, B और C का वेतन 4 : 5 : 3 के अनुपात में है। यदि A, B और C अपने वेतन से क्रमशः 10%, 25% और 15% दान करते हैं। यदि C का वेतन रु.36000 है, तो एक साथ A, B और C का शेष वेतन ज्ञात कीजिये।
questions_hin.s_hi:
Let the salary of A, B and C be 4x, 5x and 3x respectively

According to question,

3x = 36000

x = 12000

Salary of A and B is 48000 and 60000 respectively

Remaining salary of A after donation = 90% of 48000 = Rs. 43,200

Remaining salary of B after donation = 75% of 60000 = Rs. 45,000

Remaining salary of C after donation = 85% of 36000 = Rs. 30,600

Required total = 43200 + 45000 + 30600 = Rs. 1,18,800
